title: First Dive
log: Our sub, the Lanternfish, slips under the waves. A faint signal pulses far below. Let's learn to work as one crew.

title: Two Lights
log: Two beacons to recover on this dive. Each one belongs to whoever claimed it.

title: In Order
log: The beacons must come home in order: first, then second.

title: Three Echoes
log: Three echoes from the reef. Share the work.

title: The Fever Watch
log: One diver has caught a fever. They must stay out of every haul this dive.
rule: The captain picks one crew member who must win no tricks.

title: Steady Hands
log: Order matters again, with a third task riding free.

title: Last Word
log: Something must be saved for last: the task marked with the final seal.

title: Count Down
log: Three numbered beacons: first, second, third. No shortcuts.

title: The Faint Ping
log: Only the weakest sonar can catch this ping. Sonar 1 must win a trick.
rule: Sonar 1 must win a trick.

title: Four Lanterns
log: Four lanterns flicker in the kelp. Spread out.

title: Captain's Call
log: The captain chooses who carries this task. Speak up if you can do it.
rule: The captain asks who wants the tasks, then gives all of them to one crew member.

title: Final Seal
log: Four tasks, and the sealed one comes last.

title: Every Ping Answers
log: The trench answers every ping. Each sonar card must win its own trick.
rule: Every sonar card must win a trick.

title: Static Shelf
log: A static shelf scrambles our signals: you see the card, not what it means.
rule: Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest.

title: By the Book
log: Four numbered beacons. By the book, one to four.

title: The Hushed Trench
log: Silent running past the Warden's outpost. No signals at all.
rule: Silent running: no signals at all.

title: Chosen Diver
log: The captain picks one diver to carry both tasks.
rule: The captain asks who wants the tasks, then gives all of them to one crew member.

title: Jammed Relay
log: The relay is jammed: no signals until the second trick.
rule: Signals are jammed until trick 2.

title: Pressure Rising
log: Five tasks as the pressure rises; one must come first.

title: Lone Catch
log: One diver must make exactly one catch this dive.
rule: The captain picks one crew member who must win exactly one trick.

title: Twin Beacons
log: Five tasks, two of them numbered.

title: Fair Shares
log: The captain hands out the tasks one by one, fairly.
rule: The captain hands out the tasks one by one, as evenly as possible.

title: Arrows in the Dark
log: Arrows mark which of two tasks comes before the other.

title: Dead Water
log: Dead water again: signals lose their meaning.
rule: Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest.

title: Slow Burn
log: Signals jammed until the third trick, and a sealed task last.
rule: Signals are jammed until trick 3.

title: Out of the Loop
log: Another fever. Two tasks, and the patient wins no tricks.
rule: The captain picks one crew member who must win no tricks.

title: Three Steps Down
log: Three numbered steps down the slope.

title: Split the Haul
log: The captain splits six tasks between us.
rule: The captain hands out the tasks one by one, as evenly as possible.

title: Follow the Arrows
log: Four arrows, four tasks in a row, with one free task between.

title: Smallest Voice
log: The faintest sonar must win a trick while five tasks wait.
rule: Sonar 1 must win a trick.

title: Bookends
log: First, second and the sealed last task.

title: The Murk
log: Thick murk: six tasks and no meaning in our signals.
rule: Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest.

title: The Warden's Gate
log: The Warden blocks the gate. The captain hands out the tasks, and the static is back.
rule: The captain hands out the tasks one by one, as evenly as possible. Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest.

title: Into the Rift
log: Into the rift. Seven tasks, nothing else.

title: Clockwork
log: Two numbered tasks among seven.

title: One and Only
log: One diver makes exactly one catch, three tasks to do.
rule: The captain picks one crew member who must win exactly one trick.

title: Long Silence
log: No signals until the third trick, seven tasks.
rule: Signals are jammed until trick 3.

title: The Last Lock
log: Seven tasks, the sealed one last.

title: Shadow Arrows
log: Dead zone and two arrows.
rule: Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest.

title: Even Keel
log: The captain shares eight tasks evenly.
rule: The captain hands out the tasks one by one, as evenly as possible.

title: Quarantine
log: Quarantine: one diver wins no tricks while five tasks are done.
rule: The captain picks one crew member who must win no tricks.

title: Cascade
log: A cascade of three numbered tasks among eight.

title: Deep Bloom
log: Eight tasks in a blooming reef.

title: Ghost Relay
log: Ghost relay: dead zone, and no signals before trick two.
rule: Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest. Signals are jammed until trick 2.

title: Five Seals
log: Five numbered seals, one after another.

title: Blind Shares
log: The captain shares the tasks blind: the static returns.
rule: The captain hands out the tasks one by one, as evenly as possible. Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest.

title: The Last Lantern
log: Nine tasks; the sealed one comes last.

title: The Captain's Wager
log: The captain bets everything on one diver: three tasks, one carrier.
rule: The captain asks who wants the tasks, then gives all of them to one crew member.

title: Riptide Arrows
log: Dead zone with three arrows.
rule: Dead zone: a signal shows the card but not whether it is highest, only or lowest.

title: The Signal's Heart
log: The signal's heart. Silent running, seven tasks, the sealed one last.
rule: Silent running: no signals at all.
